Subject: Renewal + satellite on-prem ask (timeline & capacity)

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Quick note from Galaxy — our renewal for the primary VPC is up in December and we want to expand the footprint as part of the renewal. High level asks: add a single on‑prem satellite cluster in our Princeton lab (air‑gapped zone) and a segregated VPC in our west coast environment for analytics-only workloads.

Requested commercial changes: move the term to 24 months, change billing cadence to annual prepay (customer prefers yearly invoicing), and include a 20% uplift in reserved capacity (estimated increase from 400k to 480k token‑equivalents/month).

Timeline: procurement wants a final SOW and pricing by Nov 15 to sign before the year end. Can you send SOW + network requirements? Also need an outline of what isolation controls and on‑prem hardware footprint you recommend (we expect 2x A100 class GPUs for the satellite).

Thanks — Elaine
Elaine Chou
Director, Infrastructure & Ops
Galaxy Therapeutics

Elaine — quick technical note after reviewing your environment questionnaire. High level recommendations: 

- Princeton satellite: 2x A100 (40GB) nodes, dedicated NVMe for KV cache, isolated management VLAN. If fully air‑gapped, we will ship a containerized runtime package and remote offline update bundle; ops will be handled via on‑site engineer for kernel/OS updates.
- West Coast analytics VPC: 1x q4 quantized variant (reduced fp16) on a shared isolated pool with strict network egress rules. KV prefix caching recommended per model to cut token cost ~18%.
- Sequence length assumptions: plan for 2048 token max for analytics path, 4096 for the on‑prem workload.
- Sizing: 480k token‑equiv/month converts to ~2.5M prompt tokens/day peak; with the proposed hardware we meet low 2s p95 latency for the satellite (for 1:1 user sessions) with the batching policy we recommend.

Open question: do you require KMS integration on the Princeton host (HSM) or will customer manage keys locally? Also confirm whether they need audit log forwarding outbound or a local SIEM only.

Ive attached an ops runbook excerpt to the internal thread (not shared). If you want, I can convert that to a customer‑facing appendix.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Capacity: committed token pool increases to 480k token‑equiv/month; overage rate and burst credits described in section 2.
- Satellite On‑Prem Addendum: includes SOW reference, installation window (60 days from signature), and an escrowed offline update process if the host is air‑gapped.
- Price impact: uplift results in a 17% increase to annual spend vs current committed levels; with annual prepay we can apply a 6% prepay discount.

I attached the redline document (redline_amendment.docx) and the updated SOW. Can you confirm the billing cadence and whether procurement needs a PO prior to signature? We can route the amendment via DocuSign once you confirm.
